title: Full Stack Engineer

Develop backend functionality and integrations using Node.js. Integrate APIs and services through GraphQL and REST. Deliver commerce and content experiences using commercetools and Storyblok. What we’re looking for At least 5 years of professional software development experience . Strong hands-on experience with React, Next.js, and Node.js . Applications from candidates residing outside Istanbul will not be considered.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description: QUALIFICATIONS AND JOB DESCRIPTION Ekin is a 28-year young technology company operating in 40 countries with a growing team of 250+ people. We are shaping the future of smart cities and public safety with cutting-edge AI technologies. QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Software Engineering or a related field, Minimum 2 years of professional experience in software development, Hands-on experience with at least one of the following: Node.js, NestJS, Angular, React or Next.js, Knowledge of NoSQL databases, particularly MongoDB; hands-on experience is a plus, Familiarity with containerization and orchestration technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes; hands-on experience is a plus, Familiarity with version control and CI/CD processes using Git and tools such as Jenkins or GitLab CI/CD, Comfortable working in a Linux environment and using basic shell commands; practical experience is a plus, Ability to use modern AI tools and technologies effectively and responsibly throughout the software development process, Ability to understand technical requirements and develop independently in line with project planning, Strong communication skills and willingness to share technical knowledge and collaborate within the team, Ability to adapt to shifting priorities across multiple projects, Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, Commitment to documentation, code quality, testability and sustainable software development principles, Good command of English, both written and spoken, JOB DESCRIPTION Develop, maintain and improve features for our smart city platform, which serves customers in many countries, as well as our other products and projects, Build backend services and frontend applications using Node.js/NestJS and Angular/React/Next.js, Take ownership of development tasks in line with technical planning and deliver them end-to-end, Provide development support across different projects, including web, mobile and sensor-based solutions, as priorities require. title: Full Stack Engineer
description: Sensor Tower’s digital intelligence platform provides unparalleled insight into market trends, advertising, competitor’s strategies, and consumer/user audience across mobile, web, and gaming. Sensor Tower’s insights are trusted by more than 2,500 enterprises worldwide across tech, retail/commerce, entertainment/media, gaming, consumer packaged goods and finance. About this role: We're looking for a Full Stack Developer (main back end focus) to work on our advertising analytics platform. We gather and process BIG amounts of data and deliver meaningful insights to our customers. We have browser extensions, databases, panelists, servers, so many servers, and a great hybrid culture with coworkers locally and across the globe. There's a good mix of extremely difficult problems, impossible problems, easy problems, bugs, performance issues, and the occasional thing that's a joy to work on – join us! What you will do in a typical day: Tackle interesting performance and scalability challenges. Meticulously refactor bunches of reports decimating code size and run time while preserving results. Intelligently manage tech debt while simultaneously delivering new features for the business. Code in SQL and C# (and occasionally js) in a mixed environment (Windows and Linux but mostly Windows) utilizing AWS, SQL Server, Redshift, Mongo, EntityFramework and ASP.NET Core. Participate in a Kanban/Devops dev process with fluid requirements, weekly scrums, and potentially be on-call w/Pagerduty Be a proponent for continuous improvement, architecture, clean code, and good systems design We use Github for source control and Jira for project management We review PRs! (usually) and ship often. What you can bring: Experienced C# developer. Be able to code in C#, SQL and occasionally in Ruby. Big Plus: Comfortable reading and modifying Javascript/React. Friendly - You will be working in cross function with a lot of cool people! Love for data - Our platform provides data intelligence for the digital economy! Our Engineering Culture We believe that "Simplicity is a prerequisite for reliability." We are looking for engineers who align with our core values: Simplicity: We avoid over-engineering. We prefer the tools we already have and the most straightforward solutions over "shiny new toys." Quality: We write code that is a pleasure to read because we know code is written once but read many times. We don't cut corners, and we polish to a high level before shipping. Extreme Ownership: We don't just do the minimum. We expect you to understand the "why" behind your work and own the ultimate goal of fixing problems at their root cause, avoiding temporary band-aids. Prioritization: We focus relentlessly on what is important, not just what is urgent. Read more about some of our Technical challenges here (written by members of our engineering team): https://sensortower.com/blog/speeding-up-the-backend-with-graph-theory https://sensortower.com/blog/how-we-scaled-to-thousands-of-sidekiq-workers Fraud warning: It's common for scammers to create positions that look legitimate on other sites. To ensure your submission is considered, only apply for positions at Sensor Tower through our company website or through posts directly associated with Sensor Tower company profiles on sites such as LinkedIn, Indeed, BuiltIn or Hackajob. At no point will Sensor Tower ever ask for money, credit card, or bank account information to complete a job application. Communications received from Sensor Tower are only sent by e-mail addresses ending in sensortower.com. All Sensor Tower interviews will be conducted via phone or Zoom. At no time will a conversation be moved to an alternative email outside of sensortower.com or text. Should an issue arise that you feel we should be aware of, please contact us. Please provide your resume when applying. To all recruitment agencies: Sensor Tower does not accept third party resumes. Please do not send resumes to our jobs alias, Sensor Tower employees or any other organization location. Sensor Tower is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. Sensor Tower will not pay any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with Sensor Tower. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description: About Karub Holding Software Karub Holding Software is the technology company of Karub Holding. We build the web products, internal tools, and integrations that power the group's businesses, and we are growing a small engineering team to build them. The role We're looking for a full-stack engineer who is comfortable owning features end to end, from the database and API to the user interface. You'll work across our Node.js/Express backend, Python services, and React front end, and help shape how the product grows. This is a full-time, on-site role at our Istanbul office. What you'll do Design, build, and maintain backend services and APIs in Node.js and Express Build data processing, automation, and integration work in Python Develop responsive, user-friendly interfaces in React Own features end to end: scoping, building, testing, deploying, and monitoring Improve performance, reliability, and security across the stack, including authentication and session handling Work closely with the team to turn product needs into clear technical solutions What you bring At least 5 years of professional backend experience with Node.js/Express, at least 5 years of front-end experience with React, and at least 3 years with Python Strong, hands-on experience running Node.js and Express in production Solid Python experience (APIs, scripting, data processing, or automation) Strong React skills, including modern hooks, state management, and component design Strong experience with relational databases, mainly Amazon Aurora, PostgreSQL, and MariaDB, including schema design, query optimization, and writing efficient SQL Hands-on experience with AWS services such as EC2, Lambda, S3, RDS/Aurora, API Gateway, CloudWatch, and IAM Comfort with REST APIs, authentication (JWT/OAuth), and web security fundamentals Experience with Git, code review, and CI/CD workflows Good written and spoken English Ability to work on-site in Istanbul Nice to have Knowledge of NoSQL databases (e.g. DynamoDB, MongoDB, Redis) Familiarity with data and analytics tooling Experience integrating AI/LLM APIs or third-party services Experience at an early-stage or fast-growing company What we offer Competitive salary, based on experience Benefits package (details shared during the interview process) Real ownership and direct influence on the product A small, fast-moving team where your work ships and matters How to apply Apply via the "Apply" button on LinkedIn. Please include a link to your GitHub profile or portfolio. ——— Full-Stack Yazılım Mühendisi (Node.js / Express, Python, React) Karub Holding Software Hakkında Karub Holding Software, Karub Holding'in teknoloji şirketidir. Grup şirketlerinin işlerini yürüten web ürünlerini, iç araçları ve entegrasyonları geliştiriyoruz; bunları geliştirecek küçük mühendislik ekibimizi büyütüyoruz. Pozisyon Özellikleri uçtan uca sahiplenebilecek, veritabanı ve API'den kullanıcı arayüzüne kadar her katmanda rahat çalışan bir full-stack mühendis arıyoruz. Node.js/Express backend'imiz, Python servislerimiz ve React arayüzümüz üzerinde çalışacak, ürünün nasıl büyüyeceğine yön vereceksiniz. Bu pozisyon İstanbul ofisimizde, tam zamanlı ve ofisten çalışma şeklindedir. Neler yapacaksınız Node.js ve Express ile backend servisleri ve API'ler tasarlamak, geliştirmek ve sürdürmek Python ile veri işleme, otomasyon ve entegrasyon çalışmaları geliştirmek React ile duyarlı ve kullanıcı dostu arayüzler geliştirmek Özellikleri uçtan uca sahiplenmek: kapsam belirleme, geliştirme, test, yayına alma ve izleme Kimlik doğrulama ve oturum yönetimi dahil olmak üzere tüm katmanlarda performans, güvenilirlik ve güvenliği iyileştirmek Ürün ihtiyaçlarını net teknik çözümlere dönüştürmek için ekiple yakın çalışmak Aradığımız nitelikler Node.js/Express ile en az 5 yıl backend, React ile en az 5 yıl front-end ve Python ile en az 3 yıl profesyonel deneyim Node.js ve Express ile canlı ortamda güçlü, uygulamalı deneyim Sağlam Python deneyimi (API, script, veri işleme veya otomasyon) Modern hook'lar, state yönetimi ve bileşen tasarımı dahil güçlü React bilgisi Başta Amazon Aurora, PostgreSQL ve MariaDB olmak üzere ilişkisel veritabanlarında şema tasarımı, sorgu optimizasyonu ve verimli SQL yazma konusunda güçlü deneyim EC2, Lambda, S3, RDS/Aurora, API Gateway, CloudWatch ve IAM gibi AWS servisleriyle uygulamalı deneyim REST API'ler, kimlik doğrulama (JWT/OAuth) ve web güvenliği temellerine hâkimiyet Git, kod inceleme ve CI/CD süreçleri deneyimi İyi derecede yazılı ve sözlü İngilizce İstanbul ofisimizden çalışabilecek olmak Tercih sebebi NoSQL veritabanları bilgisi (ör. DynamoDB, MongoDB, Redis) Veri ve analitik araçlarına aşinalık Yapay zekâ/LLM API'leri veya üçüncü taraf servis entegrasyonu deneyimi Erken aşama veya hızlı büyüyen bir şirkette çalışmış olmak Sunduklarımız Deneyime göre rekabetçi maaş Yan haklar paketi (detaylar mülakat sürecinde paylaşılır) Ürün üzerinde gerçek sahiplik ve doğrudan etki Yaptığınız işin hızla yayına alındığı ve fark yarattığı küçük, dinamik bir ekip Başvuru LinkedIn üzerindeki "Başvur" butonu ile başvurun. Lütfen GitHub profilinizin veya portfolyonuzun bağlantısını ekleyin.

title: PHP Laravel Full Stack Developer with jQuery and JavaScript
description: Are you a skilled Full Stack Developer based in Europe, ready to tackle exciting challenges in the LegalTech and TravelTech industries? ✈️ Join AirAdvisor – Innovate, Lead, and Make an Impact, and work remotely from anywhere✈️ About Us At AirAdvisor , we are dedicated to ensuring air passengers receive the compensation they are entitled to for flight disruptions. Whether it’s a delay, cancellation, missed connection , or an airline-related issue like overbooking . As the only company in the industry , we also offer baggage claim services for lost and delayed luggage under a patented process. We are present in the EU, the UK, and other international markets, with a focus on protecting air passengers' rights globally. We have successfully processed over 800,000+ claims for clients from 221 countries , earning a 4.5-star rating based on 28,700+ reviews . Currently operating in 21 languages , AirAdvisor is an ambitious and fast-growing startup with a clear vision for international expansion. We plan to reach 1 million claims by the end of 2026. ✈️ About The Role We are seeking a highly skilled, results-oriented, and success-driven PHP Laravel Full-Stack Developer with strong business acumen . What You Will Do: Design, develop, and maintain backend services and web applications using PHP. Integrate frontend components using Bootstrap or Tailwind CSS, jQuery, and JavaScript. Debug, enhance, and maintain database structures and performance, and manage high-load environments with MySQL. Implement caching and messaging solutions with Redis, Memcached, and RabbitMQ. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and launch new business service features. Evaluate user feedback and collaborate with product teams to refine and improve service features based on real-world usage. Maintain and enhance legacy PHP codebases without frameworks and participate in projects to migrate legacy PHP applications to modern frameworks (e.g., Laravel). Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize existing systems, with a focus on enhancing performance, response time, and system efficiency. Proactively recommend and execute program improvements, including performance optimizations and feature enhancements. Create comprehensive technical documentation and conduct training sessions for team members on best practices and new features. What You Bring: PHP Development (extensive experience required). Strong experience with one or more PHP frameworks, ideally Laravel. Solid knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Bootstrap or Tailwind, and jQuery. Strong experience with MySQL in high-load environment s, including query optimization, indexing strategies, and data modeling. Experience with caching and messaging tools (any technology, e.g., Redis, Memcached, RabbitMQ, Kafka, etc.). Ability to work with and improve legacy PHP code without frameworks. Proven track record of building, integrating, scaling, and maintaining third-party APIs and services for high-traffic applications. Ability to communicate well in English. Nice-to have experience: Experience with RUM, Core Web Vitals, and understanding how to optimize the front end Experience with database sharding/partitioning Knowledge of parsing techniques and tools Hands-on experience with Elasticsearch Familiarity with Selenium for automated testing Experience in the LegalTech, TravelTech, and Travel Arrangements industries. Who you are as a person: Self-aware , honest , and able to take responsibility for mistakes while driving continuous improvement. Result-oriented approach , with a proven ability to deliver fast and make a significant impact on business growth, demonstrate initiative, and manage multiple projects simultaneously. Exceptional problem-solving skills and creative thinking abilities. Independence : Ability to act as a universal player, capable of working independently without constant supervision. Speed : Result-oriented, with a focus on delivering fast and making an immediate impact. Devotion : Eager to make a significant impact on the product, with a willingness to go above and beyond to achieve his goals. Excellent communication skills , with the ability to articulate complex ideas clearly and concisely. Why You’ll Love Working With Us: Remote-first culture with flexible start and end times. Your working hours will be easily recorded in our time-tracking application, allowing you to adjust your workday to your personal needs and capacity. Paid Time Off & Public Holidays, because work-life balance matters. Professional Growth Opportunities: Work on global expansion, new product and service development, and new market entry. Dynamic work and a chance to learn how to utilize your skills in an absolutely new way. Supportive Team Culture: Work with intelligent, passionate, and friendly colleagues who value collaboration. International Team: Our colleagues are located in 18 countries worldwide. Job Type : Freelance Contract / Service Agreement / FOP or a B2B Contract with the intention of long-term cooperation. ✈️If you're ready to take on a high-impact role in a fast-growing company, apply now and let's redefine air travel compensation together! ✈️ *** If you would like to be the first to know about our new job openings, company business updates, new services, and rankings related to the airports, airlines, and aviation industry, please follow our LinkedIn company page and social media profiles.

title: Backend Developer

Alongside our client projects, we continuously develop Holly Connect, our integration platform that connects Shopify with ERP systems, marketplaces, logistics providers, payment systems, and other commerce technologies. We are looking for a Backend Developer who is passionate about software development, enjoys working on complex systems and integrations, and takes ownership of delivering reliable and well-structured solutions. At least 4 years of professional, full-time experience developing applications using .NET and/or .NET Core Web API. Strong understanding of software development processes, with the ability to analyse business and technical requirements, evaluate architectural alternatives, and determine appropriate technical solutions. Professional experience working in Agile software development environments and applying Agile methodologies in practice. Previous experience working on e-commerce projects and/or systems involving ERP, CRM, shipping and logistics, or marketplace integrations. Responsibilities Develop and maintain existing and new software projects using .NET and .NET Core, contributing to both Holly Connect and client projects. Actively participate in regular team meetings and contribute to development processes in line with Agile methodologies. Support the training, mentoring, and professional development of interns by sharing technical knowledge and providing guidance. What We Offer A fully remote working environment Opportunity to work on enterprise-level commerce products and complex integrations International projects and collaboration with global brands A fast-growing, product-focused technology company The opportunity to work on projects for well-known brands alongside highly skilled teams Opportunities to explore and develop your skills with new technologies
